Global Leaders Discuss AI Regulation and Security Access

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has backed global efforts to establish guardrails for artificial intelligence (AI). Meanwhile, former US President Donald Trump has stated he will fight AI regulation. Separately, former US President Barack Obama has criticized Trump's approach to AI, issuing a warning for stronger regulation in the field. The Australian government has also been advised to engage with Trump and US AI giants regarding security access.
